Students protest at Jantar Mantar, reclaim site after dismantling

Protesters, identified as Gen Z students, reclaimed the Jantar Mantar protest site in Delhi and camped overnight after authorities dismantled their protest camp. Heavy police security was deployed at the site. Some reports highlighted the students' use of digital trends, memes, and social media in their protests, while others focused on alleged police brutality against students and the students' anger directed at mainstream media. One report noted a Mumbai man ordering food for the protesters, delivered by a Zomato rider.
